title: One Color Preprocessing Improves DSATUR
abstract: arXiv:2609.17633v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Graph Coloring Problem (GCP) is NP-hard and DSATUR stands as one of the fastest heuristics for it despite producing colorings that typically use more colors than state-of-the-art coloring algorithms. We propose SSLD (Semidefinite Spectral Learning with DSATUR), which improves DSATUR by preprocessing a first good color class before letting DSATUR complete coloring the rest of the given graph. We obtain this color class from a Semidefinite Programming (SDP), similar to an SDP used to compute the Lov\'asz theta number. To the best of our knowledge, SSLD is the first approach to improve DSATUR by preprocessing through fixed color classes. We evaluate SSLD against DSATUR and against a naive 1-color-class preprocessing algorithm on DIMACS instances, random graphs (Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi, Watts-Strogatz, Barab\'asi--Albert), Frequency Assignment and Job Shop Scheduling instances. SSLD matches or beats DSATUR in almost every case across over 160

translated_title: 一种颜色预处理方法改进DSATUR算法
translated_abstract: 图着色问题是NP难问题，尽管DSATUR产生的着色方案通常比最先进的着色算法使用更多的颜色，但它仍然是最快的启发式算法之一。我们提出了SSLD（基于半定谱学习的DSATUR），该方法通过预处理出一个良好的第一个颜色类，然后让DSATUR完成对给定图其余部分的着色，从而改进DSATUR算法。这个颜色类来自一个半定规划（SDP），其形式类似于用于计算Lovász theta数的SDP。据我们所知，SSLD是首个通过固定颜色类预处理来改进DSATUR的方法。我们在DIMACS实例、随机图（Erdős-Rényi、Watts-Strogatz、Barabási-Albert）、频率分配和作业车间调度实例上，将SSLD与DSATUR以及一个朴素的1颜色类预处理算法进行了评估。在超过160个测试实例中，SSLD几乎在所有情况下都与DSATUR持平或更优。
tldr: SSLD方法通过半定规划预处理出一个固定颜色类来改进DSATUR图着色启发式算法，在几乎所有测试实例上都能达到或超越DSATUR的性能。
en_tdlr: SSLD improves the DSATUR graph coloring heuristic by preprocessing one color class via semidefinite programming, matching or beating DSATUR on almost all tested instances.
